items.q: Should I use emojis in my bio?
items.a: A few can help structure a bio and show your style. Avoid filling the space with them, because clarity matters more.

items.q: Is the Instagram bio generator free?
items.a: Yes. The Instagram bio generator is free to use as often as you like, with no sign-up or login.

items.q: Do I have to log in with Instagram?
items.a: No. The tool never asks for your Instagram login, and you paste the bio yourself.

items.a: Yes. Our social media team handles profile setup, content, reels and ads.
